The '''Brentaal-Denon Route''' was a major ancient [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperroute]] from [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] to [[Denon/Legends|Denon]]. In [[3703 BBY]], it was used to extend a stable path to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], eventually becoming integrated into the future [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].
